messages.content: Do not confuse WorkspaceID with workspace_id. Frontend prop is WorkspaceID, API field is workspace_id, database column is workspaceId, and audit event is workspace.exported.v2. Export job id example: exp_20260611_ABcd42. Region: us-east-1.
Exact identifiers: WorkspaceID, workspace_id, workspaceId, workspace.exported.v2, exp_20260611_ABcd42, us-east-1.
